bug_report:
[15 regression] ICE on CTAD for alias template with type constraint
The following C++20 code causes an ICE in trunk.
```c++
template <class, class>
concept C = true;

template <class T, class U>
struct pair {
    constexpr pair(T, U) {}
};

template <class T>
struct S {
    template <C<T> U>
    using P = pair<T, U>;
};

S<int>::P p{42, ""};
```

Output:
```
<source>:15:19: internal compiler error: same canonical type node for different types 'S<int>::P<U>' and 'pair<int, U>'
   15 | S<int>::P p{42, ""};
      |                   ^
0x2913db5 diagnostic_context::diagnostic_impl(rich_location*, diagnostic_metadata const*, diagnostic_option_id, char const*, __va_list_tag (*) [1], diagnostic_t)
	???:0
0x292add6 internal_error(char const*, ...)
	???:0

	???:0

	???:0
0xbc423a cp_finish_decl(tree_node*, tree_node*, bool, tree_node*, int, cp_decomp*)
	???:0
0xcee07b c_parse_file()
	???:0

	???:0
```
